title: Programme Entitlements Published by Each Car Rental Rate Class
content:
Three programme entitlements are published by rate class: the share of the rental total that accrues as
traveller club points, whether a club tier may obtain a vehicle class upgrade, and whether a corporate
travel programme rate may be applied. The table covers all six Car Rental Rate Classes.

| Rate class | Points accrual, as a percentage of the rental total | A club tier may obtain a class upgrade | A corporate programme rate may be applied |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Pay Now Saver Rate | 0 | no | no |
| Pay Now Standard Rate | 50 | no | no |
| Pay At Counter Flex Rate | 75 | yes | yes |
| Inclusive Flex Rate | 100 | yes | yes |
| Premium Inclusive Rate | 125 | yes | no |
| Corporate Negotiated Drive Rate | 0 | no | yes |

The accrual figure is a percentage and not a number of points: 100 per cent is the ordinary accrual of the
Inclusive Flex Rate, 125 per cent the enhanced accrual of the Premium Inclusive Rate, and 50 and 75 per cent
the reduced accruals of the Pay Now Standard Rate and the Pay At Counter Flex Rate. Two classes publish
nothing.

The two later columns answer different questions and do not move together. The Premium Inclusive Rate
permits an upgrade but takes no corporate programme rate; the Corporate Negotiated Drive Rate takes a
corporate programme rate but permits no upgrade; the Pay At Counter Flex Rate and the Inclusive Flex Rate
answer yes to both, and the two Pay Now classes answer no to both.
